supervision: binary image-level tumor labels only for classifier/CAM generation; validation polygons only for post-prediction diagnostic metrics

protocols.ground_truth: known binary image label selects tumor CAM; known normals are explicit empty masks

recipe.scientific_variable: SAM proposal generation only: replace CAM-component point/box prompts with the official 32-by-32 dense automatic-mask grid gallery
recipe.proposal_and_ranking_cam: trained CPM direct CAM, official four scales 0.5/1/1.5/2 plus horizontal-flip TTA; frozen coverage_mass_sam score
recipe.selection_aggregation: global top-1 fallback because dense gallery proposals have no CAM-component identity; score formula is unchanged
recipe.support_semantics: frozen promoted baseline global support clipping

evaluation: full clean validation; all 184 tumors count end-to-end, including image-gate skips and empty predictions; 187 normals reported separately
